title: Nuclear slowing-down factors in alkali-metal vapors
summary: Nuclear slowing-down factors account for the sharing of angular momentum between the electron and the nucleus in the effective Bloch description of alkali-metal spin dynamics in the spin-exchange-relaxation-free (SERF) regime. For collinear optical pumping and magnetic field, we find that longitudinal and transverse spin dynamics are characterized by different polarization-dependent slowing-down factors.
